- **Filter:** `JwtAuthenticationFilter.doFilterInternal` only authenticates when `isValid(token) && !isRevoked(token)`. A revoked token is not rejected with an error. Three rules in the `notaire.auth` group fire on login outcomes. All three are in `infra/observability/prometheus/alert-rules.yml`:

- **HighLoginFailureRate** (warning): fires when more than 50% of login operations are non-success over 5m, held for 2m.
- **SuspiciousLoginActivity** (critical): fires when `status="bad_credentials"` logins exceed 0.5/s over 2m, held for 1m.
- **LoginLockoutSpike** (warning): fires when any `status="locked"` login is recorded over 5m, held for 1m.

Routing is in `infra/observability/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml`. Every alert goes to one receiver, `default`, which has no configuration. The file's own comment says no external channel is set up because that needs credentials, which is an owner decision. So these alerts are only visible in the Alertmanager UI and Grafana; nothing pages or notifies anyone. The one inhibit rule suppresses warnings when a critical alert fires for the same `service` label, so during a brute-force event SuspiciousLoginActivity would hide the two warnings.
